meaning: Seven architectural interrogations, not seven new pipeline stages, owners or mandatory implementations. Selected direct branches may bypass intermediate products only if their corresponding invariants survive.

boundaries.name: original source to governed canonical evidence
boundaries.producers: SAV/DTA, actual instrument, release, QSM, source and rights issuer
boundaries.receivers: S01/S1-E I02 direct body and complete sealed C11
boundaries.must_preserve: native question/option/code semantics, respondent and occurrence identity, form/translation/routing, eligibility, missing/not-asked/unreleased, survey design, population/time and source authority
boundaries.first_effect: actual source-selected response, weight, routing or permission changes or refuses a cold authenticated C11 first read
boundaries.veto: irreversible question/response/routing/instrument observability loss or positive on denied source
boundaries.owners: PYAT source, QSM, U/Epre and C11 physical owners

boundaries.name: canonical evidence to respondent-coherent empirical computation
boundaries.producers: sealed C11, native I03/I05/Batch, query issuer
boundaries.receivers: F1-F4 and qualified descriptive query recipients
boundaries.must_preserve: same-respondent >=3 true joint and repeated/ranked observations, conditioned risk set, weighted/unweighted denominators, direction of reverse conditional, minority and routing negatives, uncertainty and replay
boundaries.first_effect: mutate true 3-way joint at fixed marginals; F4 and qualified consumer change; invalid body/fate denies; exact restore matches
boundaries.veto: pairwise products, full-body replay per operation, false zero or unproved negative

boundaries.name: empirical computation to differentiated social-field possibility
boundaries.producers: F1-F4 and qualified Field Forge descriptive machinery
boundaries.receivers: FF01/EPR and planned N10E/SEAM social-field recipient
boundaries.must_preserve: multiple positions with full conditional configurations, minority alternatives, limits of survey sample, no unwitnessed individual co-presence or identity inference
boundaries.first_effect: qualified position-specific distribution changes an admissible option/description at actual or explicitly held first reader
boundaries.veto: marginal-only field, impossible proxy respondent identification, unqualified generalization to all persons
boundaries.owners: PYAT Field Forge #1009 and PRE-V3 receiving owner

boundaries.name: descriptive field plus external structural evidence to objective-world relations
boundaries.producers: qualified FF descriptive products and independently sourced material/structural issuer
boundaries.receivers: N9 and N10W where selected; direct N10E otherwise preserved
boundaries.must_preserve: observed prevalence separate from causal/structural claims, control/resources/sanctions/tenure, F6 numerical and nonpooling, F7 measured comparability, historical/current/as-of time
boundaries.first_effect: hold survey fixed, change legitimate material relation; selected world opportunity changes, while empirical facts do not
boundaries.veto: survey opinion treated as institutional power or modeled likelihood asserted as causal fact
boundaries.owners: PYAT FF02 N9/N10E/N10W, independent structural scientist

boundaries.name: objective possibility to particular fictional world and encounter constraints
boundaries.producers: N9/N10E/N10W accepted world possibility, separate world-particularization rules
boundaries.receivers: PRE-V3/SOROK world, C0/P2 and legitimate actor ingress
boundaries.must_preserve: positions and surrounding others, actual institutional/material access, physical/fictional history time, source vs modeled vs authored identity, branch and commitment ancestry
boundaries.first_effect: same empirical evidence, different admissible world arrangement changes available encounter/opportunity without changing source
boundaries.veto: sample respondent becomes character, unknown actual kinship fabricated as surveyed, proposed event counted performed
boundaries.owners: PYAT N11/N12 seam and SOROK competent world particularizer

boundaries.name: situated encounter to independent developing person
boundaries.producers: SOROK admitted actor/world access and event, not PYAT psyche
boundaries.receivers: SOROK C0-C12/A0-A5 actual activity, interpretation and continuing reader
boundaries.must_preserve: distinct objective event, actor access, perception, knowledge, motives, activity, no-change, unobserved inner history and nonautomatic identification
boundaries.first_effect: accessible vs inaccessible event yields distinguishable permitted actor consequence; no-access cannot create knowledge
boundaries.veto: survey answers cause mandatory private motives or world change automatically modifies actor state

boundaries.name: performed activity and worldly consequence to next historical situation
boundaries.producers: SOROK committed activity and separately authorized shared-world effect
boundaries.receivers: SOROK subsequent world/actor; PYAT scientific redrive only on separate qualified external source
boundaries.must_preserve: event clock, causal dependencies, shared-world consequences, committed past, branch replay, no retroactive mutation of real survey observations
boundaries.first_effect: actual eligible performed action changes a later actor's opportunity while alternative branch and original survey remain unchanged
boundaries.veto: fictional effect edits empirical C11, hypothetical branch rewrites sealed past, automatic child care change from parent job
boundaries.owners: SOROK P2/world action response; separate PYAT N9/SDTF when externally justified

r6_note: Terms T1–T7 fixed. Test source-to-claim, original respondent topology, real negative, first downstream consumer, legal held extension. Future direct routes may bypass intermediate stages where owners lawfully provide direct outputs.
